'''Point Down''' was an influential base for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]]. [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces later managed to capture [[Camp Aurek/Legends|Camp Aurek]], Point Down, and [[Outpost Shear]].<ref name="HNN 14:9:01" />
